name: Can I install garage flooring over an existing painted or sealed concrete floor?

mainEntity.name: Can I install garage flooring over an existing painted or sealed concrete floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing new garage flooring over an existing painted or sealed concrete floor requires proper surface preparation. Often, the existing coating must be completely removed or thoroughly abraded (ground down) to create a clean, porous surface for the new material to adhere properly. Applying new coatings or tiles over a poorly prepared surface can lead to delamination, bubbling, or premature failure. Your contractor will assess the existing floor condition and recommend the necessary preparation steps to ensure long-term adhesion and performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Existing painted or sealed floors usually require thorough preparation, often involving removal or abrasion, to ensure proper adhesion of new materials and prevent failure.
